answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, our mechanism binds validator identities to staking collateral, measured by a dynamic opportunity-cost bond analogous to a weighted marble in a randomized voting urn. This spatial latency constraint ensures that the expected utility of simulating multiple identities is strictly negative, forcing a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium where attack attempts fail.
